name: OKC_K_KEY_TERMS
description: This table captures the extracted key terms for a contract.

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the extracted key term.

columns.name: DNZ_CHR_ID
columns.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the contract header.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Reference to the contract major version.

columns.name: KEY_TERM_EXTRACT_ID
columns.description: Reference to the key term extraction.

columns.name: KEY_TERMS_CODE
columns.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the key term code.

columns.name: RAW_VALUE
columns.description: Key term value returned by the LLM.

columns.name: UPDATED_VALUE
columns.description: Updated key term value by the publisher.

columns.name: UPDATED_VALUE_NUMBER
columns.description: If the updated value is number it is stored in this field.

columns.name: UPDATED_VALUE_DATE
columns.description: If the updated value is date it is stored in this field.

columns.name: MEASURE
columns.description: Stores the Unit Of Measure of the UPDATED_VALUE_NUMBER.

columns.name: PROMPT_ID
columns.description: Reference to the unique identifier of the prompt.

columns.name: SOURCE_FROM_ID
columns.description: Stores the ID of OKC_K_KEY_TERMS from where it is being referenced. This is FK to self OKC_K_KEY_TERMS. If its value is null, its from same version.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Classification type of the key terms. Stores lookup code which is based on lookup type ORA_OKC_KEY_TERMS_CLASSIFY_CODE.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
